response.justification: The candidate is an accomplished polyglot engineer with 10+ years of experience, but the profile is almost entirely web/backend (TypeScript, Node.js, DLang) rather than the C++/Windows capital-markets stack this role requires. C++ exposure is limited to roughly seven months at National Instruments in 2014–2015, with no evidence of recent hands-on C++, no SQL Server or Oracle depth, no Windows-platform systems work, and no fixed income, derivatives, or investment-banking domain experience (RIDE Capital is retail/wealth fintech, not capital markets). The mandatory criteria are unmet on all three primary axes, so this is not a viable screen-through despite strong general engineering credentials.
strengths: Broad 10+ year engineering track record across web, embedded, and low-latency systems
Demonstrated low-latency, high-throughput microservice work at Dunnhumby/Sociomantic
Strong engineering practices: TDD, CI/CD, DevOps tooling, public speaking and teaching
concerns: C++ experience is ~7 months and over a decade stale; no Windows platform focus
No fixed income, derivatives, or investment-banking/capital-markets domain exposure
SQL listed only generically; no SQL Server or Oracle depth evidenced
